alerts.headline: Dense Fog Advisory issued November 19 at 6:13AM CST until November 19 at 10:00AM CST by NWS Austin/San Antonio TX
alerts.description:
* WHAT...Visibility as low as one quarter mile or less in dense fog.

* WHERE...A portion of south central Texas.

* WHEN...Until 10 AM CST this morning.

* IMPACTS...Low visibility could make driving conditions hazardous.
alerts.instruction:
If driving, slow down, use your headlights, and leave plenty of
distance ahead of you.

alerts.headline: Special Weather Statement issued November 19 at 3:25AM CST by NWS Austin/San Antonio TX
alerts.description:
Latest observations are showing patchy dense fog across much of the
Coastal Prairies into parts of the I-35 Corridor. Reports of 1/4
mile are coming in as of 3 AM at both Giddings and Gonzales.
Other nearby stations are reporting between 1/2 mile and 3 miles
of visibility. Use cation when driving in fog. Leave extra space
ahead of you and use low-beam headlights.
